title: rosa canina var. obtusifolia
intro: Rosa canina var. obtusifolia, commonly known as the Dwarf Dog Rose or Obtuse-leaved Dog Rose, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to support digestive health, boost immune system function, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. obtusifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid. The health benefits of Rosa canina var. obtusifolia are mainly due to its high content of vitamin C, which plays a crucial role in collagen production, iron absorption, and immune system function.
